macros.title: Crypto deposit pending / not credited yet
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Thanks for reaching out, and I understand waiting on a deposit is frustrating. Crypto deposits need confirmation by miners before the funds are credited to your Stake balance, and if the network fee paid was too low, the transaction may take longer to be confirmed. You can check the current status here: https://stake.com/transactions/deposits

If it still isn't showing, please share the transaction hash for your {{amount}} {{crypto}} deposit. You can find it in the wallet you sent from: open your transaction history, select the transaction sent to Stake and copy the hash. Guide: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/5218535-how-to-find-your-transaction-hash

macros.title: Deposit sent on wrong network or unsupported coin/token
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

I'm really sorry to hear about this, and I understand how stressful it is. Stake only accepts specific coins and networks for deposits, and transactions of non-accepted coins or coins sent via the wrong network will not be credited. Stake also does not support token deposits, no matter the coin or network, and networks such as Arbitrum, Optimism and Base are not supported.

You can find the full list of supported coins and networks here: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/7980790-acceptable-blockchain-networks-for-cryptocurrencies
For any future deposit, please double-check the network and send a small test amount first, as blockchain transactions are usually irreversible.

macros.title: XRP/EOS deposit missing MEMO/TAG
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Thanks for letting us know. XRP and EOS deposits require both the correct address and a MEMO/TAG to be credited to your Stake balance, and when a mistake like this happens, we can initiate a recovery process for you. To get started, please share the transaction hash of this deposit along with the exact amount you sent. You can find the hash in the transaction history of the wallet you sent from: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/5218535-how-to-find-your-transaction-hash

For future deposits, please always include your destination tag (memo) so the transaction can be credited to your account.

macros.title: How to deposit crypto and supported networks
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Happy to help! Your email and account need to be verified first, and then you can deposit like this:
1. Go to your Wallet on the Stake homepage.
2. Click on Deposit and select the coin you want to use.
3. Follow the deposit instructions shown, making sure you send via a supported network for that coin (for example, USDT: ERC20, BSC (BEP20), Polygon, Tron (TRC20) or Solana).

Full list of supported coins and networks: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/7980790-acceptable-blockchain-networks-for-cryptocurrencies
There is no maximum deposit limit, but deposits under $0.01 can't be processed automatically. If you don't own any coins yet, you can buy crypto with your credit card through the Moonpay service on our site (Wallet > Buy Crypto).

macros.title: INR deposit pending - how to escalate (Enquire Now)
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Thanks for your patience, and I'm sorry for the wait. Please note that 24 hours is the normal waiting time for INR deposits, so pending transactions can't be escalated before then. After that, you can enquire directly from the Deposit page:
1. Go to Account > Transactions > Local Currency and click on the transaction in the Status column.
2. If escalation is available, you'll see an "Enquire Now" button.
3. Enter your UTR number, add a screenshot of your proof of payment and press Submit.

Your enquiry is sent to the payment provider, so please make sure all details are correct, and you'll receive an update as soon as the provider checks your case. Guide: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/14450116-how-to-escalate-a-missing-deposit

macros.title: Deposit Wager Requirement Before Withdrawal
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Every deposit made on Stake.com must be wagered 100% before withdrawals or tips can be made. For example, if you deposit $100 in any currency, bets of $100 in total must be placed before you can withdraw or tip those funds. You can see how much is left on the tracking bar on the withdrawal page, and sports bets only count once the game ends and the bet is settled, not when it is placed. Depositing and then withdrawing without placing any bets is treated as coin mixing, and such a withdrawal will be invalid. Please only ever play with amounts you are comfortable with.

macros.title: Payments Temporarily Unavailable - Local Currency Not Supported
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},
Thanks for reaching out. The "Payments Temporarily Unavailable" message may appear because local currency is not supported on our platform for your country. This is related to regulatory requirements and restrictions that vary by region, so unfortunately it is beyond our control. Please also make sure the country you entered during Level 1 verification is the country where you are located, as this determines eligibility for local currencies. In the meantime, you can use crypto for your transactions; here is the list of supported cryptocurrencies: https://stake.com/blog/what-crypto-does-stake-offer and our local currency guide: https://stake.com/blog/local-currency-deposit-withdraw-guide

macros.title: Please Wager Before Withdrawing - 100% Fiat Deposit Rule
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},
The "Please wager before withdrawing" message means that 100% of the value of your local currency (fiat) deposit needs to be wagered before a fiat withdrawal can be requested. This rule applies to all deposits made in local currency and is set out in Clause 8.5 of our Terms of Service: https://stake.com/policies/terms
It is in place to prevent misuse of funds and maintain the integrity of our betting system, and withdrawals are only released once the 100% requirement is reached. Please only ever play with amounts you are comfortable with.

macros.title: Local Currency Card Deposit (Visa/Mastercard) - How To and Missing Option
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},
You can deposit with Visa or Mastercard in selected local currencies:
1. Go to the Wallet tab.
2. Select Deposit > Local Currency > Debit/Credit Card.
3. Select your desired deposit amount.
4. Enter your card details and click Set Amount.
The card option only appears if it is available for your selected currency and location, so if you don't see it, please check whether your preferred currency is supported in your country. Card deposits are processed in near real time, although in some cases they can take 1-3 business days.

macros.title: Monthly Bonus - How the Amount Is Calculated
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

I understand you'd like to know more about your monthly bonus amount. It is calculated using several criteria: your VIP rank, your gameplay since the last monthly bonus (or the previous 30 days if the bonus was issued within that timeframe), your profit values for the month, and the house edge of the games you play. For example, after an unlucky month you might receive a bit extra on top of the monthly bonus, and games with a higher house edge offer a higher monthly bonus percentage than games with a lower edge.

Pre-monthly and post-monthly bonuses may also be sent before or after the monthly bonus, but they aren't guaranteed each month and occur at random. Also, claiming your monthly bonus in crypto gives you more value compared to other currency options.

More info: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/9945945-how-is-the-monthly-bonus-calculated

macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

I'm sorry to hear you missed a reload claim. Unfortunately, once a reload claim is missed or the reload offer expires, it cannot be retrieved. As a reminder, reloads are limited to one claim every 24 hours based on availability, and a reload cannot be modified once claimed.

macros.title: VIP Progress: How to Calculate What's Left to the Next Level
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},
You can see your current VIP progress percentage on the homepage once you're logged in. Here's how to work out what's left until your next level (example: Bronze at 45%):
1. Subtract your current level requirement from the next level's requirement: $50,000 - $10,000 = $40,000.
2. Multiply your progress percentage by that amount and divide by 100 to get what you've wagered so far: 45 x $40,000 / 100 = $18,000.
3. Subtract that from the requirement to see what's left: $40,000 - $18,000 = $22,000.
Sports bets count 3x more, so for sports you can divide the remaining amount by 3. If you mix sports and casino bets, your transaction history shows your total wagered. More details: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/4974712-how-to-calculate-your-vip-progress

macros.title: Proof of Identity - Accepted Documents & Photo Requirements
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

For proof of identity we accept an International passport, a National ID card (both sides) or a Driving licence (both sides). Other types of document will not be accepted.

Please make sure that:
1. You upload the original photo, in high resolution and in colour. Screenshots and documents in digital format are not accepted.
2. The document is easily readable, with no flash or blurriness, and the entire document is visible in a flat position.
3. The document is not physically damaged, is valid for at least 3 months and is in Latin international format.

You can upload it here: https://stake.com/settings/verification

macros.title: Selfie with ID - Step-by-Step Tips
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Here is how to take a selfie with your identity document so it can be reviewed:
1. Make sure your ID is clean and free of any glare or shadows, and stand in front of a well-lit background, preferably with natural light.
2. Hold your ID in one hand next to your face without covering your face, so we can clearly see both your face and the ID.
3. Look straight at the camera, avoid accessories (e.g. sunglasses, a hat, headband, glasses) and do not use flash.
4. Keep your hand steady to prevent blurry images, and make sure the document is not flipped or mirrored.
5. The photo must be in colour and high resolution, in an image format like JPG or PNG (compressed zip files are not accepted).

Full guide: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/7916730-taking-a-selfie-with-an-identity-document-a-step-by-step-guide

If you are based in Japan, Internet and TV bills are also not accepted, so please use an electricity, gas or water bill instead.

1. Is an original photograph or PDF (screenshots will not be accepted).
2. Was issued within the last six months and is in Latin international format.
3. Clearly shows your complete name and address, the name of the issuing entity and the date of issue, with the entire document visible.

macros.title: Source of Income - Accepted Documents
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Our compliance team reserves the right to request any documentation at any given time. If you have been asked for proof of your source of income, accepted documents include:
1. Bank statements clearly showing regular incoming payments (e.g. salary, pension, fees) over a period of time (usually 3-6 months), with your name, account number, the bank's name and address, and both sender and recipient details visible.
2. Paychecks showing your name, your employer's name, address and gross pay.
3. Other sources with supporting documents, e.g. tax returns, investment statements, a written statement from the donor for gifts, a copy of the will or trust document plus a death certificate for inheritance, or a copy of the deed or title plus a property tax bill for real estate.

Please send an original photograph or PDF (no screenshots), issued within the last six months and in Latin international format, with your complete name and address, the name of the issuing entity and the date of issue clearly visible.

Full list: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/5328395-proof-of-source-of-income-acceptable-documentation

Hi {{user}},

Our compliance team reserves the right to request any documentation at any given time. If you have been asked for proof of your source of income, accepted documents include:
1. Bank statements showing regular deposits and withdrawals over a period of time (usually 3-6 months) and clearly showing regular incoming payments (e.g. salary, pension, fees), with your name, account number, the bank's name and address, and both sender and recipient details visible.
2. Paychecks showing your name, your employer's name, address and gross pay.
3. Other sources with supporting documents, e.g. tax returns, investment statements, a written statement from the donor for gifts, a copy of the will or trust document plus a death certificate for inheritance, or a copy of the deed or title plus a property tax bill for real estate.

Please send an original photograph or PDF (no screenshots), issued within the last six months and in Latin international format, with your complete name and address, the name of the issuing entity and the date of issue clearly visible.

macros.title: Account Closure - Close Your Account
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

You can close your account yourself at any time, with no need to contact support:
1. Go to Responsible Gambling > Account Closure in your account settings: https://stake.com/responsible-gambling/account-closure
2. Select your reason for closing your account and confirm.
3. Your account will be closed immediately.

If you can't use this option or would prefer our team to close it for you, please email accountclosure@stake.com from your registered email address. Once closed, the account can't log in, receive bonuses or receive promotional material. If you ever want to reactivate it, this is subject to a 24-hour cooling off period and can be requested at accountclosure@stake.com from your registered email.

More info: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/10763642-closing-your-account

macros.title: Self Exclusion - Indefinite Exclusion & Return to Play
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Thank you for reaching out, we're here to support you. Self Exclusion suspends access to your entire account and is set indefinitely, with a minimum period of 6 months from the application date:
1. Go to Stake Smart > Self Exclusion: https://stake.com/responsible-gambling/exclusion
2. Click on "Request Self Exclusion".
3. Confirm Self Exclusion.

Once it takes effect, you won't be able to engage in any further activities on your account. After the 6 months have passed, the account can be considered for reactivation, subject to a formal return-to-play review that you can start by emailing support@stake.com. If you'd like extra support, Gambling Therapy (https://www.gamblingtherapy.org/) and Gamblers Anonymous (https://gamblersanonymous.org/ga/) are available to help.

More info: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/4793477-self-exclusion

macros.title: Break in Play - Temporary Account Break
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

If you'd like a short break from gambling, you can use Break in Play, which is available for 1 Day (24 hours), 2 Days, 1 Week or 1 Month:
1. Go to Stake Smart > Self Exclusion: https://stake.com/responsible-gambling/exclusion
2. Click on "Request Break in Play".
3. Confirm the final period.

While the break is active you won't be able to engage in any activities on your account, and it will automatically reopen once the period you selected has ended. If you feel you need a longer break, Self Exclusion is also available and I'm happy to explain it.

More info: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/9874126-break-in-play

macros.title: Product Exclusion - Block Casino, Sportsbook or Poker Only
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

You can block just one product while the rest of your account stays active, so deposits, withdrawals and the chatroom keep working as usual.
- Casino or Sportsbook: go to Responsible Gambling > Self Exclusion (https://stake.com/responsible-gambling/exclusion), select Request Product Exclusion, choose Casino or Sportsbook, choose your duration (24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or Indefinite) and select Continue. It is applied immediately.
- Poker: Poker exclusion isn't part of that tool. Just tell me your preferred time frame (1 day, 2, 3, 5 or 7 days, 1, 2, 3 or 6 months, 1 year, or indefinitely) and our team will apply it within minutes.

Please note that fixed-period exclusions cannot be reversed once in place and must expire on their own. For an indefinite Casino or Sportsbook exclusion, you can request a return to play at any time by emailing support@stake.com from your registered account email, subject to manual review.

More info: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/8249384-product-exclusion

macros.title: Deposit, Loss & Wager Limits - Setup & Cooling-Off
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Setting limits is a great way to stay in control of your play. Here's how they work:
- Deposit limits: for local currencies we currently support a daily limit only. Crypto deposits that exceed your limit are held in a withholding balance, and an amount equal to your limit is released into your account once your daily limit resets.
- Loss and wager limits: available daily, weekly or monthly. Click the "Responsible Gambling" tab from your account, open "Gambling Limits", choose the limit type, amount and period, then select "Add Limit".

Setting or decreasing a limit applies immediately, while increasing a limit (or removing a deposit limit) is subject to a 24-hour cooling-off period for your protection.

More info: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/11847196-deposit-limits and https://help.stake.com/en/articles/8247959-gambling-limits

macros.title: Voided Bet Explained
macros.body:

1. The match was canceled or abandoned before completion.

3. The market had no clear winner, such as Draw No Bet when the match ends in a tie.
4. In rare cases, the offer was incorrect, as outlined in the sportsbook rules.

macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

- In a Same Game Multi, if any selection on the bet slip is voided, the entire bet slip is voided as per sportsbook rules, because these bets are placed on a custom-created market using selections from the same match.

macros.title: Cashout Not Available
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Thanks for your patience. Cashout isn't available on every market or event, and these are the most common reasons:
1. The event or market has been suspended. The specific market and its line must be available for betting.
2. A time delay is applied to every Cashout, so an attempt may fail if the market is suspended or the odds change after the delay.
3. Cashout is not available for Same Game Multi bets, and player-prop bets can only be cashed out pre-match.
4. The event or market has no live coverage (no live odds are offered).

Please note your Cashout value varies with your selection's performance and may be higher or lower than your original stake. The full rules are here: https://stake.com/policies/sportsbook#General

Quarter lines (.25/.75) split your wagered amount in half between the nearest whole and half lines, so the result can be a Win, Half Win, Half Loss, or Loss. macros.title: Affiliate Commission Calculation
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

The standard affiliate commission is 10%, but the amount you receive depends on the house edge of the games your referred players enjoy. These formulas are used:
1. Casino: house edge as decimal x wagered / 2 x commission rate
2. Sportsbook (3% theoretical house edge): 0.03 x wagered / 2 x commission rate
3. Poker: rake x commission rate (rake is the small percentage of each poker pot collected as a hosting fee)

You can check your commission payout here: https://stake.com/affiliate/commission
